exposure: ratio of triglyceride to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (TG/HDL-C)
cohort: The study participants were nulliparous singleton pregnant women.
finding: Higher maternal triglyceride-glucose index (TyG index) and triglyceride to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (TG/HDL-C) ratio in late gestation are associated with a significantly higher incidence of fetal macrosomia.
